overview_description.description: Testsigma is a cloud-based platform that uses artificial intelligence to help businesses automate testing for web, mobile, and API applications. It allows testers to create and run tests faster and easier, with features like natural language processing and AI-powered maintenance. Testsigma integrates with popular CI/CD tools and offers a free trial.

about_short_description.short_description: Testsigma is a cloud-based continuous testing platform that is designed to automate test for mobile and web apps.

product.name: Testsigma Unified Test Automation Platform
product.description: A cloud-based, low-code platform for creating, executing, maintaining, analyzing, and reporting automated tests across web, mobile, desktop, API, Salesforce, SAP, and other applications.

identifier.value: Web, Mobile, Desktop, Salesforce, and SAP Test Automation

product.name: Web, Mobile, Desktop, Salesforce, and SAP Test Automation
product.description: Automated functional and end-to-end testing for web, native and hybrid mobile, Windows desktop, Salesforce, and SAP applications using low-code and plain-English test creation.

product.name: Automated API Testing
product.description: A low-code API automation service for designing, importing, executing, and validating REST and SOAP API tests, including chained requests, data-driven scenarios, and CI/CD execution.

product.name: Cross-Browser and Cross-Device Testing
product.description: Automated testing across browsers, operating systems, screen sizes, mobile devices, and emulators, with parallel execution, real-device access, network conditions, and visual validation.

identifier.value: AI in QA Certification and Training

product.name: AI in QA Certification and Training
product.description: A training and assessment program that teaches QA professionals how to use AI agents, prompt engineering, autonomous test automation, and AI-assisted test analysis.
